summary: Join our Sustainable Agriculture and Farm Management Course to learn innovative techniques for sustainable farming and enhance your farm management skills.
lede: Sustainable agriculture and farm management connect farm production decisions with soil, water, biodiversity, and resource stewardship. This training is for people who make or support farm decisions, helping them assess baseline conditions, plan soil and nutrient management, improve irrigation efficiency, use integrated pest management, and turn farm records into measurable performance reports.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate course is for professionals who make or support daily decisions about sustainable agriculture, farm production, natural resources, compliance records, and agricultural supply chains. It suits people who need a structured approach without assuming advanced agronomic modelling, programming, or specialist certification experience.
prerequisites: No formal certification or university qualification is required. You should have practical exposure to farming, agricultural advisory work, farm operations, food supply chains, or sustainability records. Basic spreadsheet use helps, but coding and programming are not required. Advanced topics such as satellite monitoring, AI-assisted pest detection, life-cycle assessment, and GHG accounting receive conceptual or operational introduction rather than technical engineering instruction. Bring representative farm records if available, such as input registers, soil test results, irrigation logs, yield records, or audit findings.
